short: Money or usage that is already paid for.
whyItMatters: Three unrelated things share the word: prepaid cash, included usage that expires monthly, and a spending ceiling that is not money at all. Confusing them changes what you think you can spend.

meanings.meaning: $5 starter credit and a prepaid wallet. Its per-instance “budget” is a ceiling, not money.
Plan dollars converted to machine time, expiring monthly. Time packs never expire.
$30 of credit after adding a card; then a prepaid wallet.
Included usage equal to the monthly fee, reset monthly.
Older pages call the $19 included usage “credits”; current pages say “included usage”.
Free usage is a resource bucket (GiB-hours, vCPU-hours), not dollars. Automatic top-ups earn 5% extra credit.
Plan time expires monthly; wallet money does not.

checkFor: Ask: is it money or usage, does it expire, and can it pay for storage and egress or only compute?
